extra_provisions.basis: Investments and Dispositions by Loan Parties to non-Loan Party Subsidiaries capped at $5,000,000 unless ordinary course, bona fide and not for liability management purposes
A Subsidiary may be designated Unrestricted only if it does not own or operate all or substantially all of the assets of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries

omni.basis: Post-LME exchange terms: Unrestricted Subsidiary concept removed (re-introduction a sacred right); non-guarantor and JV baskets capped and barred for any liability management transaction; J.Crew protection extended to all non-guarantors and material Collateral as a sacred right

not_counted.B18: Section 7.17 Priming Financing/Liability Management Transaction covers non-pro-rata uptier exchanges only, not dropdowns
not_counted.B87: Pluralsight Provision applies only if the primary purpose is new financing or lien release, as determined by the Borrower Representative (already coded R=YES from the blocker)
not_counted.anti_subordination: Sacred rights against payment or lien subordination are recorded in subordination_sacred and do not count as dropdown protection
